description:
The Avare aviation GPS app is open on the main map screen. Your task:
1. Tap the 'Plan' tab at the bottom of the screen to open the flight plan view.
2. In the 'Add Waypoint to Plan' input field, clear any existing text and type 'KSFO'.
3. Tap the 'Search' button to add KSFO (San Francisco International) as a waypoint.
4. In the same input field, type 'KLAX' and tap 'Search' to add KLAX (Los Angeles International) as a second waypoint.
5. The flight plan should now show both KSFO and KLAX in the waypoint list with distance calculated.
6. Verify the plan shows two waypoints: KSFO as departure and KLAX as destination.
